title: Planning a bug that changes a function's verdict lists the suite assertions that pin the old verdict, and puts their test file in the touches
goal: precheck warns of a committed bug or story whose goal changes what a named function returns (a window, a verdict, a count) when a test file outside its touches calls that function, naming the file, so planning adds it (set ID --add-touch) or records why not before the start; in SP-vdrsfftl BG-vzsk2t5t's touches left out the live kb test file, whose two fixtures pinned the old window_sections fallback, so its worker stopped with a gate and had to be resumed with widened touches

run:
import sys,tempfile,subprocess,io,contextlib,argparse,os
sys.path.insert(0,'_tools')
import bl_base,bl_land
def one(**v):
    return {'BG-bbbbbbbb': v}
def run(sg,items,files=()):
    d=tempfile.mkdtemp()
    subprocess.run(['git','init','-q',d],check=True)
    for p,t in files:
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(os.path.join(d,p)),exist_ok=True)
        open(os.path.join(d,p),'w').write(t)
    subprocess.run(['git','-C',d,'add','-A'],check=True)
    bl=bl_base.Backlog(d)
    bl.items['SP-aaaaaaaa']=dict(id='SP-aaaaaaaa',kind='sprint',title='s',status='planned',goal=sg)
    for k,v in items.items():
        it=dict(id=k,sprint='SP-aaaaaaaa',status='draft',title='t',checks=[dict(run=['python3','-c','import sys; sys.exit(1)'])])
        it.update(v)
        bl.items[k]=it
    o=io.StringIO()
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(o):
        bl_land.cmd_precheck(bl,argparse.Namespace(sprint='SP-aaaaaaaa'))
    return [l for l in o.getvalue().splitlines() if l.startswith('warning')]
files=[('_tools/mod.py','def window_sections(x):\n    return x\n'),('_tools/test_mod.py','import mod\nassert mod.window_sections(1) == 1\n')]
goal='window_sections returns the whole article when no window is found, not an empty list.'
bad=run('g',one(kind='story',goal=goal,touches=['_tools/mod.py']),files)
good=run('g',one(kind='story',goal=goal,touches=['_tools/mod.py','_tools/test_mod.py']),files)
sys.exit(0 if any('test_mod.py' in l for l in bad) and not any('test_mod.py' in l for l in good) else 1)
